summary: Code review PASS. All 6 acceptance criteria verified by direct source inspection, PHPStan (zero errors on modified files), and PHPUnit (47/47 tests, 63 assertions).
trigger_error() → DataGridException is architecturally correct: typed exceptions are catchable, testable, and self-documenting. The exception message is actionable.
PAGE_SENTINEL public const visibility is appropriate — internal consumers already reference it; external pagination providers may need it for sentinel-based URL template extraction.
Known coverage gap (SelectionCell::renderContent() empty-value path) acknowledged and tracked as low-priority debt.

comments.note: trigger_error() → DataGridException is the architecturally correct move. PHP errors are not catchable without a custom error handler; typed exceptions integrate with try/catch and PHPUnit's expectException() cleanly. The exception message is actionable ('Call $grid->actions()->setValueColumn() before rendering') — exactly what a developer seeing this at runtime needs.

test_renderContent_emptyValue in SelectionCellTest.php is now a misnomer: it no longer tests renderContent() — it tests getSelectionCell() throwing on missing value column. The test is correct, but the method name should eventually be renamed to test_getSelectionCell_throwsOnMissingValueColumn. Low-priority rename; no functional impact.

SelectionCell::renderContent() with empty value is effectively dead code and is no longer directly tested. This is a consequence of pushing the guard up to getSelectionCell() where it belongs. The dead code path in renderContent() could be removed in a follow-up, further simplifying SelectionCell.
No blocking issues. All changes are minimal, correct, and well-scoped. PHPStan: zero errors on modified files.
